disclaimer: These profiles are configurable dissertation comparison anchors. Thresholds are experimental starting points — not universal industry standards.

profiles.name: General Broadband
profiles.description: Everyday residential broadband comparison profile for Mauritius-oriented QoS studies.

download_mbps.rationale: Anchors mid-tier advertised FTTH download for compliance scoring, not a claimed national minimum.
download_mbps.description: Target mean download throughput for this profile.

upload_mbps.rationale: Asymmetric residential plans often advertise much lower upload; 20 Mbps is a local comparison anchor.
upload_mbps.description: Target mean upload throughput for this profile.

ping_ms.rationale: Interactive browsing and general responsiveness typically feel good under ~20 ms RTT on island paths.
ping_ms.description: Maximum mean ICMP/TCP latency considered compliant.

jitter_ms.rationale: Low delay variation supports stable everyday interactive use.

packet_loss_pct.rationale: Loss above ~0.5% often degrades TCP and real-time apps; used as a soft compliance gate.
packet_loss_pct.description: Maximum mean packet loss considered compliant.

dns_lookup_ms.rationale: Page start and app connect times suffer when DNS exceeds tens of milliseconds.
dns_lookup_ms.description: Maximum mean DNS lookup time considered compliant.

overall_score.rationale: Aligns with the existing Excellent/Good boundary used elsewhere in the platform.
overall_score.description: Minimum mean overall QoS score considered compliant.

download_mbps.rationale: Modern online games rarely need very high sustained throughput; responsiveness dominates.
download_mbps.description: Target mean download for gaming sessions.

upload_mbps.rationale: Upload mainly carries player state; modest capacity is usually enough.
upload_mbps.description: Target mean upload for gaming sessions.

ping_ms.rationale: Competitive play degrades as RTT rises; 40 ms is a practical island-path stretch target, not an esports standard.
ping_ms.description: Maximum mean latency for gaming compliance.

jitter_ms.rationale: Jitter causes rubber-banding even when average latency looks acceptable.
jitter_ms.description: Maximum mean jitter for gaming compliance.

packet_loss_pct.rationale: Loss forces retransmits and visible hitches in real-time games.
packet_loss_pct.description: Maximum mean packet loss for gaming compliance.

dns_lookup_ms.rationale: Matchmaking and CDN redirects still depend on timely DNS.
dns_lookup_ms.description: Maximum mean DNS lookup for gaming compliance.

overall_score.rationale: Slightly lower composite gate than general broadband because gaming weights latency harder in practice.
overall_score.description: Minimum mean overall QoS score for gaming compliance.

profiles.name: Video Conferencing
profiles.description: Two-way video meeting comparison profile (Zoom/Teams-class use).

download_mbps.rationale: HD receive streams are modest; uplink and stability matter more than peak download.

upload_mbps.rationale: Outbound camera streams need sustained uplink more than download.

ping_ms.rationale: Conversational turn-taking degrades as delay rises.

jitter_ms.rationale: Jitter creates audio artefacts and frozen frames in RTC stacks.

packet_loss_pct.rationale: RTC can conceal small loss; above ~1% quality drops quickly.
packet_loss_pct.description: Maximum mean packet loss for conferencing.

dns_lookup_ms.rationale: Meeting join still depends on resolving service endpoints.
dns_lookup_ms.description: Maximum mean DNS lookup for conferencing.

overall_score.rationale: Composite gate for meeting-ready connections under this profile.
overall_score.description: Minimum mean overall QoS score for conferencing.

profiles.name: Streaming
profiles.description: One-way video streaming / IPTV-style consumption profile.

download_mbps.rationale: Rough HD/4K adaptive-stream headroom; not a codec-specific bitrate claim.

upload_mbps.rationale: Playback is download-dominated; upload remains a light control-plane need.

ping_ms.rationale: Streaming tolerates higher RTT than interactive apps if throughput is stable.

jitter_ms.rationale: Buffers absorb some variation; large jitter still causes rebuffering.

packet_loss_pct.rationale: Loss forces bitrate drops and stalls in ABR players.
packet_loss_pct.description: Maximum mean packet loss for streaming.

dns_lookup_ms.rationale: CDN hostname resolution affects start-up time more than mid-stream quality.
dns_lookup_ms.description: Maximum mean DNS lookup for streaming.

overall_score.rationale: Composite gate weighted toward sustained download success.
overall_score.description: Minimum mean overall QoS score for streaming.

download_mbps.rationale: Codec bitrates are small; voice quality is delay/loss dominated.

upload_mbps.rationale: Symmetric voice streams need only modest capacity each way.

ping_ms.rationale: ITU-T G.114 one-way delay guidance is often cited near 150 ms; 100 ms RTT is a conservative round-trip stretch target for this profile, not a regulatory limit.

jitter_ms.rationale: Jitter buffers hide some variation; beyond ~20–30 ms voice quality suffers.

packet_loss_pct.rationale: Even small loss rates create audible artefacts in VoIP codecs.
packet_loss_pct.description: Maximum mean packet loss for VoIP.

dns_lookup_ms.rationale: Registrar / SBC lookups affect call setup more than media quality.
dns_lookup_ms.description: Maximum mean DNS lookup for VoIP.

overall_score.rationale: Composite gate emphasising stability over peak throughput.
overall_score.description: Minimum mean overall QoS score for VoIP.

download_mbps.rationale: Higher sustained download for multi-user sites and cloud sync — still a local target, not an SLA.
download_mbps.description: Target mean download for enterprise use.

upload_mbps.rationale: Business uploads (backups, CCTV, SaaS) need more uplink than residential plans.
upload_mbps.description: Target mean upload for enterprise use.

ping_ms.rationale: Interactive remote desktops and APIs benefit from low RTT.
ping_ms.description: Maximum mean latency for enterprise use.

jitter_ms.rationale: Stable delay supports voice, video, and transactional apps on the same link.
jitter_ms.description: Maximum mean jitter for enterprise use.

packet_loss_pct.rationale: Stricter loss gate than residential profiles for business criticality.
packet_loss_pct.description: Maximum mean packet loss for enterprise use.

dns_lookup_ms.rationale: Enterprise SaaS login and directory lookups are latency-sensitive at the edge.
dns_lookup_ms.description: Maximum mean DNS lookup for enterprise use.

overall_score.rationale: Aligns with the Excellent rating band for stricter business comparisons.
overall_score.description: Minimum mean overall QoS score for enterprise use.
